response.sql: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles FROM player AS p JOIN batting_postseason AS bp ON bp.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), player_indices AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS index_value FROM player_averages), hand_averages AS (SELECT bats, AVG(index_value) AS hand_average_index FROM player_indices GROUP BY bats) SELECT pi.player_id, pi.bats, pi.average_doubles, pi.index_value AS "index", pi.index_value - ha.hand_average_index AS index_minus_hand_average FROM player_indices AS pi JOIN hand_averages AS ha ON ha.bats = pi.bats ORDER BY (pi.index_value - ha.hand_average_index) IS NULL, index_minus_hand_average DESC LIMIT 10;
